top_signals.title: Q-Dir and DesktopOK Windows utilities compromised to push Python RAT
top_signals.summary: Official distribution channels for the Q-Dir and DesktopOK Windows utilities were compromised to deliver trojanized installers containing Python-based remote access malware. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
